book_meta.work: short stories by Guy de Maupassant and Anton Chekhov
book_meta.author: Maupassant (d. 1893) and Chekhov (d. 1904)
book_meta.status: public domain — retold from the plots, not from any translation

sentences.ar: امرأة عجوز عايشة لحالها ببيت بالغابة.
sentences.en: An old woman lived alone in a house in the forest.

sentences.ar: ابنها الوحيد كان بالجيش بعيد عنها.
sentences.en: Her only son was in the army far from her.
Four enemy soldiers were quartered with her.
They were young, and began helping her with the work.

sentences.ar: كانت تطبخ لهم وهم يجيبوا لها حطب.
sentences.en: She cooked for them and they brought her firewood.
One of them showed her a picture of his mother.

sentences.ar: بيوم، وصلها مكتوب إن ابنها انقتل.
sentences.en: One day, a letter reached her that her son had been killed.

sentences.ar: قرته مرتين وقعدت ساكتة طول النهار.
sentences.en: She read it twice and sat silent all day.

sentences.ar: بالليل، طلبت أسماء الجنود الأربعة وأسماء أمهاتهم.
sentences.en: At night, she asked for the four soldiers’ names and their mothers’ names.
She wrote them on a paper and put it in her pocket.
And then she set the house alight while they slept.
She stood outside and waited for the soldiers to come.

sentences.ar: أعطتهم الورقة وقالت: قولوا لأمهاتهم مين عملها.
sentences.en: She gave them the paper and said: tell their mothers who did it.
